def blocks(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    scores={}
    for v in {x for r in g for x in r}:
        if v==0: continue
        fr=sum(1 for i in range(H) if all(g[i][j]==v for j in range(W)))
        fc=sum(1 for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==v for i in range(H)))
        scores[v]=(fr,fc)
    s=max(scores,key=lambda v:(scores[v][0],scores[v][1]))
    hr=[i for i in range(H) if all(x==s for x in g[i])]
    vc=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==s for i in range(H))]
    def seg(seps,n):
        res=[];p=0
        for e in sorted(set(seps)|{n}):
            if e>p: res.append((p,e)); p=e+1
        return res
    rb=seg(hr,H); cb=seg(vc,W)
    return s,rb,cb

def shapes_in(g):
    s,rb,cb=blocks(g)
    shapes={}
    for (r0,r1) in rb:
        for (c0,c1) in cb:
            cells=[(i-r0,j-c0,g[r0+i][c0+j]) for i in range(r1-r0) for j in range(c1-c0)
                   if g[r0+i][c0+j]!=0 and g[r0+i][c0+j]!=s]
            if cells: shapes[(r0,c0)]=cells
    return s,rb,cb,shapes

for pair in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    gi=G[pair+' input']; go=G[pair+' output']
    s,rb,cb,shapes=shapes_in(gi)

    for k,cells in sorted(shapes.items()):
        norm=sorted((x[0]-min(x[0] for x in cells),x[1]-min(x[1] for x in cells)) for x in cells)

    diffs=[(r,c,go[r][c]) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]]
    # which room? group diff by row band & col block
    for (r0,r1) in rb:
        line=''
        for (c0,c1) in cb:
            d=[d for d in diffs if r0<=d[0]<r1 and c0<=d[1]<c1]
